figure_id.description: Stable identifier referenced by paper_section.prose_html via .

caption.description: Operator-language caption. Reader should grasp the figure's takeaway from caption alone.

data_spec.description: Per-figure-type data references. Keys depend on figure_type. Examples: { 'metric_key': 'loco_auc_per_cell', 'cells_key': 'loco_cells' }. The figure renderer validates required keys before drawing.

alt_text.description: Accessibility alt text. Defaults to caption if omitted.
